name: THOUSAND SONS: RUBRIC MARINES
description: Rubric Marines advance at the command of their sorcerous master, laying down withering hails of fire. Arcane shells from their inferno weapons and soulreaper cannons blast the enemy apart, while gouts of mutagenic fire from their warpflamers burn and twist both flesh and soul. Against such an onslaught, none can stand for long.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds ten Rubric Marines, utterly implacable infantry for your Thousand Sons armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. Led by an Aspiring Sorcerer who directs them in battle as a puppeteer would operate a marionette, they are ideal for clearing enemy-held objectives in a hail of lethal firepower before claiming it for themselves.</br></br>The Aspiring Sorcerer in the squad has a choice of two heads, two toppers for his force staff, and the choice of an inferno bolt pistol, warpflame pistol, or an open hand. The other members of the squad can be armed with either an inferno boltgun or warpflamer, one can be built with an optional soulreaper cannon, and another can carry an optional icon of flame. The arms, weapons, and torsos are interchangeable across the miniatures, as are the 10 other heads, 10 backpacks, and 20 shoulder pads, making it easy to customise your unit.</br></br>This kit comprises 152 plastic components, and 10x Citadel 32mm Round Bases. These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
